title: Full E2E login flow test
body: Write an E2E test that goes through the full login form flow: navigate to /login, fill credentials, submit, verify redirect and session works for frontend routes
rationale: The existing tests mock next/headers or bypass the frontend form. No test covers the actual login form → session → protected route flow end-to-end.

title: Investigate why page remained at /login
body: The issue describes page remaining at /login with no error shown after submit. This could indicate a separate bug in how handleSubmit processes the login result or how window.location.href redirect works
rationale: The cookie header fix helps session validation, but doesn't explain why the redirect didn't happen in the first place if login was successful.
